verdict.rationale: Auth0 documents an official CLI for managing tenant configuration, automating tasks, and integrating into development and deployment workflows, and the CLI repo is confirmed. The Client Credentials (M2M) flow is documented as suited to CLIs, daemons and backend services, which supports non-interactive authentication. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of non-interactive CLI auth and CI pipeline usage (e.g., GitHub Actions examples), and independent or hands-on corroboration of headless/CI runs.
